Re: Request for Meeting on Misinfo and Promoting Authoritative Content
[contact omitted] Josh Blumenfeld Friday, November 18, 2022 at 5:20:59 PM Eastern Standard Time
To: [contact omitted] Colin Thomas-Jensen
[contact omitted] Connie LaRossa, [contact omitted] Johnny Walsh, [contact omitted] Vera Zakem,
[contact omitted] Ria Strasser-Galvis
Hi Colin,
Circling back on this, would love to find a time to speak with you all. Also, FYSA, some of our senior execs will be in town
in early December and would love to see the Administrator. We'll reach out under separate copy for that.
Many thanks,
Josh
On Fri, Nov 11, 2022 at 7:50 AM Josh Blumenfeld [contact omitted]> wrote:
Awesome thank you! Youtoo.
On Thu, Nov 10, 2022 at 5:42 PM Colin Thomas-Jensen <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Thanks very much, Josh. Great to see you as well and l am very happy to be back. I'd be very interested in learning
more about this. Johnny, Vera and I will circle up on our schedules and get back to you next week.
Hope you have a great weekend
colin
On Thu, Nov 10, 2022 at 2:29 PM Josh Blumenfeld < [contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Colin, Johnny, and Vera,
Colin, nice seeing you a few weeks ago and welcome back!
I'm reaching out to see if we could brief you all on misinformation and raising authoritative content, and how proposed
reforms to Section 230 could impact these efforts. Though of course 230 is a US domestic regulatory issue, as you
can imagine, the foreign policy and national security implications are significant, beyond CVE efforts, extending to
human rights, freedom of the press etc.
Might you and/or your colleagues have some time in the coming days?
Many thanks,
Josh
Google Public
Policy Joshua R. Blumenfeld (he/ him)
